name: Gods Glory
overview: Scripture reveals that God's glory is both manifest in creation and supremely revealed in Christ, who is the exact representation of God's nature and the hope of glory for believers. The heavens declare God's glory as evidence of His handiwork, yet all have sinned and fallen short of this glory. Despite human failure, all things exist by, through, and for God, to whom eternal glory belongs. Christ's incarnation and redemptive work make known the riches of this glory, inviting believers into a restored relationship with God.
